subject: akane-gwen
label: The Oath — married common-law
from: Married, with no ceremony recorded behind it
to: Married common-law, by Oath ceremony. Gwen is Akane's Knight
note: The Archive reached this the long way and both wrong turns are worth keeping. It first recorded them simply as Married, with nothing behind it. It then over-corrected to NOT MARRIED at all, which was worse. The truth is narrower and better: Gwen's paladin oath forbids her a marriage in the legal sense, so the Arc 10 Oath ceremony is what they had instead, and they are married common-law. She is Akane's brat-wife. She took Akane's name with no certificate anywhere in it — a knight who cannot sign, signing herself over in the only ink she has.
